content.text:
I built the part and exported it to `submission.step`. It's a flat rectangular mounting plate, 100 mm long (X) × 7 mm thick (Y) × 40 mm tall (Z), with four Ø3.2 mm through-holes along Y. The holes are in two pairs, one pair near each end (x = ±42 mm), each pair 10 mm apart vertically. The exported file was read back and is one valid solid with the same volume and size as the model.

**How well it matches:** the silhouettes overlap the four reference views with a mean IoU of about 0.964. That's an estimate from the images, not the final score, which comes from voxel IoU against the real part. I tried four sets of proportions:

| Size (X × Y × Z, mm) | Mean IoU |
|---|---|
| 100 × 6 × 32 | 0.849 |
| 100 × 10 × 40 | 0.948 |
| **100 × 7 × 40 (submitted)** | **0.964** |
| 100 × 5.5 × 38 | 0.922 |

I also tried laying the plate flat (thin in Z), which scored only 0.721, so the upright orientation is right.

- **Hole sizes are guesses:** I estimated hole size and spacing by eye. The silhouette comparison can't see through-holes, so those numbers aren't checked by it.
- **`compare.png` is out of date:** it still shows the 5.5 mm attempt. I didn't re-render it after going back to the 7 mm plate. The STEP file is the 7 mm version.
- **No editable feature tree:** the part was built with a script, so it can't be edited as features. That doesn't affect the STEP file.
